visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a moving vehicle, a young Asian man with light brown hair and glasses, identified as the main character, drives while speaking enthusiastically to the camera. He wears a black puffer vest over a dark long-sleeved shirt. Urban street scenery is visible through the car windows. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a Michelin tire shop. The main character stands smiling, holding a new tire vertically in front of him. Behind him, rows of various tires are neatly stacked on shelving units under bright fluorescent lighting. (3) A close-up montage shows the technical process of changing the tires. A technician in a blue uniform operates a tire-changing machine to remove the old rubber from a multi-spoke alloy rim. A digital balancing machine screen is briefly visible. (4) The main character is seen actively participating in the work, using a red power impact wrench to tighten the lug nuts on the wheel of a white Lexus SUV. He gives an 'OK' hand gesture and points to the Michelin logo. (5) Transition to an indoor office counter. The main character leans over a bill, looking concerned while speaking to a female clerk wearing a face mask and a uniform. A detailed service price list is mounted on the wall. (6) In a spacious car repair workshop, the main character talks with another man wearing a headlamp, known as Bao Ge. They stand over the open engine bay of the white SUV, gesturing towards the mechanical components. (7) Back in the car interior, the main character holds up a paper receipt and a document toward the camera, speaking with a satisfied expression while continuing to drive through the city.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal (Han Han) speaking rapidly over a quirky, acoustic comedy BGM featuring bouncy piano and light percussion. His tone is boastful and excited. (2) A sharp 'Whoosh' SFX marks a transition. The BGM continues as he loudly promotes the tire service. Occasional off-screen laughter from a second male is audible. (3) Mechanical impact sounds (pneumatic drills and metallic clangs) are layered into the mix as tire work is shown. (4) A percussive 'Ding' SFX accompanies a meme-style edit. (5) The audio environment shifts to a quieter office tone. A female clerk's voice is calm and low in volume, contrasting with Han Han's exaggerated comedic whining about the bill. (6) In the workshop, the ambient room tone is more hollow. Banter between two men is clear and conversational, with the BGM providing a constant, playful bed. (7) The video concludes with high-arousal speech from Han Han, emphasizing the receipt and final costs, ending with a final comedic flourish in the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Narrative Setup -> Execution -> Conflict -> Resolution -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and promote a used car dealer's high-standard preparation process for a sold vehicle, specifically highlighting a premium tire change at Michelin and general maintenance to build consumer trust through transparency and humor.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal mention of Michelin tires, visible brand logos on merchandise and signage, and filming the entire service within a branded store.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully balances commercial promotion with lifestyle vlog content by using a humorous persona and fast-paced editing. The inclusion of the 'payment conflict' scene makes the content more relatable and trustworthy.
